task_card.title: TTS in Vision: resolve Qwen3-TTS viability, then wire Chatterbox + Qwen as Flows

next_action.description: Start MPI-622 Phase 0 - the only thing blocking the voice library. Fabio can perform emotion ONLY in his own voice (~100 Hz, register R1), and a live voice changer CANNOT carry emotion because it mangles pitch, which is what emotion rides on. Test the offline route first: take one of his natural angry takes, pitch-shift it +7 and +12 semitones formant-preserving, drive TTS -> VC into a matched-register character, and ask him two separate questions - does it still read as angry, and do chipmunk/formant artefacts ride through. If that fails, research permissively-licensed emotional speech corpora (a real gap: the existing voice-library research covers IDENTITY corpora only). If both fail, take the escape hatch already written into the plan and ship R1-only for v1. Also get Fabio's answer on MPI-622 D1 and D2.

key_decisions: FLOW A IS NOT DROPPED - Fabio, 2026-08-25: 'It's not a dead product. It just needs to give the user truthful information about how it works.' The obligation is guidance, not a better model. Do not reopen this.

THE ROUTE DECIDES THE VOICE. Direct TTS lands on the character; TTS->VC lands on a consistent OTHER voice. So register is a property of the VOICE, never of the line - a per-line neutral-bypass would switch actor mid-scene. 'Flat' is a performance clip, not a bypass.

DIRECT TTS WITH NO VC IS EXCELLENT FOR DICTATION - Fabio's tutorial voice came back 'exactly the same thing'. The 2026-08-23 'direct sounds robotic' note is scoped to the EMOTION tests only and must not be generalised.
Offline Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign authoring does NOT contradict 'Qwen3-TTS is never shipped' - it is an authoring tool that never becomes an app dependency. The vd_* / A3_REF clips all came from it.
Sourcing is ALREADY RESEARCHED - kyutai/tts-voices 228 CC0 ships now, VCTK + GLOBE upgrade. Do not re-research it.
constraints: NEVER GATE ON THE COSINE ALONE. CAMPPlus is pitch/prosody-invariant by construction and scored 0.92 on a clip a listener placed 20 years off target. Two different library voices of different genders score 0.75 to each other, so anything under ~0.8 carries almost no information. Gate = cosine AND median-f0 delta (librosa.pyin).

A LISTENING TEST WHERE VC PRESERVES THE SCRIPT IS NOT BLIND. VC keeps the source's words, rhythm and duration exactly, so any A/B against the source is decided by content in one second. Use a cold DESCRIPTION of a clip whose source the listener does not know.

Deps are SINGLE FILES with a sha256 - there is no archive/extract dep type. A 228-file library cannot ship through the download manager without inventing one. comfy_workflows/display/ is the existing in-repo convention and copyAppTree ships the app tree wholesale.
